card.name: The article "a" before a quantity
card.fires_on: The word "a" or "an" right after "at least", "more than", "once" or "either", just before a number or size. It is mostly in dosing and measurement text.

modes.label: After either
modes.description: "a" follows "either" and leads into a size choice such as a needle gauge.
